scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm --prefix functions run check && npm run build
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-nummo --import emulator-seed
scripts.test:emulator: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-nummo --import emulator-seed "node tests/emulator/backend.e2e.ts"
scripts.emulators:real: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project real --only functions,firestore
scripts.test:emulator:real: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project real --only functions,firestore "node tests/emulator/realAuth.e2e.ts"
